scripts.dev:dbCore-migrate: cd packages/db/dbcore && npx prisma migrate deploy && cd ../..
scripts.dev:dbTimescale-migrate: cd packages/db/db-timescale && npx prisma migrate deploy && cd ../..
scripts.dev:dbCore-generate: cd packages/db/dbcore && npx prisma generate && cd ../../..
scripts.dev:db-timescale-generate: cd packages/db/db-timescale && npx prisma generate && cd ../../..
scripts.start:http: pnpm run dev:dbCore-migrate && pnpm run dev:dbTimescale-migrate && cd apps/http_backend && node dist/index.js
